title: The water loop — 28 machine-checked theorems and how they are bound
description:
The water loop. 28 machine-checked theorems from the Lean 4 source file src/proof/energy.lean, by Tsvetan Rouschev, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Lean 4 is a proof checker: a theorem it accepts has been checked by its kernel, not argued in prose. 21 are checked case by case over a stated finite domain (by decide). 7 are proved for every value, on the standard axioms only (propext, Quot.sound; the verifier refuses any other). Every theorem listed is sealed live in the deposit's ledger, where a withdrawal is marked in place; 63 earlier rows removed on 2026-08-09 are listed in src/proof/revoked.json.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used here in a precise, non-quantum sense: theorems are bound when they derive from shared definitions (section 1), when their files import one another (section 2), and when their content-addressed receipts fold into one address that changes if any one of them changes (section 3). It is correlation by derivation; no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 15 definitions are used by two or more theorems, binding 87 pairs; the theorems fall into 7 strands, the largest of 22. Most binding: pct (7), splitCost (5), mgH2 (5), mgH2O (5), burnYield (4), mgO2 (4). 5 theorems name no definition of the file and stand on their own statement.

2 · Imports. Built on: no other cluster. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 1 file: src/proof/energy.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 28 sealed receipts fold to e98e2a32-7df5-83b7-988a-8206e44a3384. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed when this record was generated. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (7, 3, 4, 4, 2, 7, 4). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs counted from this cluster's theorems' seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: demand.lean (6 observed, 2.64 expected, lift 2.27), merkaba.lean (4 observed, 1.92 expected, lift 2.08), address.lean (11 observed, 6 expected, lift 1.83). A best lift is the largest of about 32 small ratios, so chance alone gives a typical best lift of 2.27 here (the median over 200 seeded reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to); one at least as high as this cluster's arose in 50.0% of them — consistent with chance. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 15.62; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.51. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). These figures are as of commit 019737516dc4 (2026-09-15), over 817 points; a new seal anywhere moves them.

Prior art. The laws of electrolysis — Michael Faraday, 1834; the enthalpy of combustion of hydrogen, standard physical chemistry. Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json (main branch). No novelty is claimed here.

The theorems.

  1. any_yield_below_its_cost_reads_under_the_whole — (List.range' 1 60).all (fun c => (List.range c).all (fun y => pct y c < 100)) ∧ burnYield < splitCost ∧ pct burnYield splitCost = 23 record
  2. a_chain_of_efficiencies_can_only_lose — (List.range 101).all (fun a => (List.range 101).all (fun b => a * b ≤ 100 * a && a * b ≤ 100 * b)) record
  3. the_cost_per_litre_multiplies_back_to_the_cost — (List.range' 1 20).all (fun l => (splitCost / l) * l ≤ splitCost && splitCost < (splitCost / l + 1) * l) ∧ splitCost / waterOut = 5777 ∧ splitCost / waterOut > roPerLitre * 1000 record
  4. the_two_to_one_is_forced_by_the_oxygen — balances 2 2 1 = true ∧ balances 1 1 1 = false ∧ (((List.range' 1 9).flatMap (fun a => (List.range' 1 9).flatMap (fun b => (List.range' 1 9).filter (fun c => balances a b c)))).length = 4) ∧ balances 4 4 2 = true ∧ balances 6 6 3 = true ∧ balances 8 8 4 = true record
  5. the_mass_balance_is_the_atom_balance — mgH2 = mass 2 0 ∧ mgO2 = mass 0 2 ∧ mgH2O = mass 2 1 ∧ (List.range' 1 9).all (fun a => (List.range' 1 9).all (fun b => (List.range' 1 9).all (fun c => (a * mass 2 1 == b * mass 2 0 + c * mass 0 2) == balances a b c))) ∧ 2 * mgH2O = 2 * mgH2 + mgO2 record
  6. the_atom_table_decides_the_balance — (List.range' 1 9).all (fun a => (List.range' 1 9).all (fun b => (List.range' 1 9).all (fun c => (a * atomsH2O.1 == b * atomsH2.1 + c * atomsO2.1 && a * atomsH2O.2 == b * atomsH2.2 + c * atomsO2.2) == balances a b c))) record
  7. the_gases_are_two_to_one_and_consume_each_other_exactly — 2 * 1 = 2 ∧ (2 * 100 / 3 = 66) ∧ (1 * 100 / 3 = 33) ∧ ¬ (1 * 1 = 2) record
  8. a_part_and_its_rest_read_back_the_whole — (List.range' 1 40).all (fun w => (List.range (w + 1)).all (fun a => per10k a w + per10k (w - a) w ≤ 10000 && 10000 ≤ per10k a w + per10k (w - a) w + 1)) ∧ mgO2 * 100 / (2 * mgH2) = 793 ∧ per10k (2 * mgH2) (2 * mgH2O) = 1119 ∧ per10k mgO2 (2 * mgH2O) = 8880 ∧ 2 * mgH2O - 2 * mgH2 = mgO2 record
  9. mass_is_conserved_at_every_scale_so_the_loop_cannot_make_water — (List.range' 1 100).all (fun n => 2 * n * mgH2O == 2 * n * mgH2 + n * mgO2) ∧ ¬ ((List.range' 1 100).all (fun n => n * mgH2O == n * mgH2 + n * mgO2)) record
  10. one_litre_split_returns_one_litre_burnt — 111900 + 888100 = 1000000 ∧ 888100 * 100 / 111900 = 793 record
  11. only_oxy_hydrogen_burns_without_admitting_nitrogen — 7808 * 100 / 2095 = 372 ∧ 0 * 372 = 0 ∧ ¬ (372 = 0) record
  12. splitting_then_burning_is_the_identity_at_the_ideal — (List.range 1000).all (fun e => burnE (splitE e) == e) ∧ pct burnYield splitCost = 23 record
  13. splitting_then_burning_is_the_identity_at_every_ledger_value — ∀ e : Nat, burnE (splitE e) = e record
  14. the_gas_volume_reads_back_its_moles — (List.range 1000).all (fun m => molesOf (litresOf m) ≤ m && m ≤ molesOf (litresOf m) + 1) ∧ molH2 = 2 * molO2 ∧ litresOf molH2 = 11117 ∧ litresOf molO2 = 5558 ∧ (litresOf molH2 + litresOf molO2) / 9 = 1852 record
  15. two_parts_in_three_is_two_thirds_at_every_scale — (List.range' 1 500).all (fun m => pct (2 * m) (3 * m) == 66) ∧ pct molH2 (molH2 + molO2) = 66 ∧ pct (2 * mgH2) (2 * mgH2O) = 11 record
  16. the_energy_per_litre_multiplies_back_to_the_energy — (List.range' 1 30).all (fun l => (whPerKgH2 * 100 / l) * l ≤ whPerKgH2 * 100 && whPerKgH2 * 100 < (whPerKgH2 * 100 / l + 1) * l) ∧ whPerKgH2 * 100 / litresOf molH2 = 299 ∧ petrolWhL * 100 / 299 = 3244 record
  17. compression_scales_the_energy_per_litre_linearly — (List.range 100).all (fun k => 2 * whPerLitreAt k ≤ whPerLitreAt (2 * k) && whPerLitreAt (2 * k) ≤ 2 * whPerLitreAt k + 1) ∧ whPerLitreAt 42 = 1398 ∧ petrolWhL / whPerLitreAt 42 = 6 record
  18. a_ratio_and_its_reciprocal_multiply_back_to_the_whole — (List.range' 1 40).all (fun b => (List.range' 1 b).all (fun a => pct a b * pct b a ≤ 10000 && 10000 < (pct a b + 1) * (pct b a + 1))) ∧ pct splitCost burnYield = 433 ∧ pct burnYield splitCost = 23 ∧ 9 * 1000 / (burnYield / 1000) = 750 record
  19. the_loss_and_the_yield_read_back_the_input — (List.range' 1 60).all (fun c => (List.range (c + 1)).all (fun y => (c - y) + y == c && 99 ≤ pct (c - y) c + pct y c && pct (c - y) c + pct y c ≤ 100)) ∧ splitCost - burnYield = 40000 ∧ pct (splitCost - burnYield) splitCost = 76 ∧ pct burnYield splitCost = 23 record
  20. the_residue_ratio_is_the_same_at_every_volume — (List.range' 1 200).all (fun l => residueMg l tdsSeawater == 700 * residueMg l tdsTapWater) ∧ residueMg 100 tdsSeawater / 1000 = 3500 ∧ residueMg 100 tdsTapWater / 1000 = 5 record
  21. the_atoms_read_back_from_the_mass — (List.range 10).all (fun h => (List.range 10).all (fun o => atomsOf (mass h o) == some (h, o))) ∧ atomsOf mgH2 = some (2, 0) ∧ atomsOf mgO2 = some (0, 2) ∧ atomsOf mgH2O = some (2, 1) record
  22. two_parts_in_three_is_two_thirds_at_every_scale_for_every_m — ∀ m : Nat, 0 < m → pct (2 * m) (3 * m) = 66 record
  23. burning_then_splitting_is_the_identity_above_the_bond — ∀ e : Nat, bondHundredthsKJ ≤ e → splitE (burnE e) = e record
  24. one_part_in_three_is_a_third_at_every_scale_for_every_m — ∀ m : Nat, 0 < m → pct m (3 * m) = 33 record
  25. the_gas_volume_reads_back_its_moles_for_every_m — ∀ m : Nat, molesOf (litresOf m) ≤ m ∧ m ≤ molesOf (litresOf m) + 1 record
  26. the_mass_names_the_molecule_below_5333_hydrogens — ∀ h o h' o' : Nat, h < 5333 → h' < 5333 → mass h o = mass h' o' → h = h' ∧ o = o' record
  27. the_boundary_is_sharp — mass 5333 0 = mass 0 336 record
  28. a_floor_division_multiplies_back_within_one_divisor — ∀ a l : Nat, 0 < l → a / l * l ≤ a ∧ a < (a / l + 1) * l record
